P1 sideways scroll (scrollWidth 1500 > 1440)
P1 elements past the right edge: div.tile, p.x
P2 content is off-centre by -40px (content 300-1300, area 240-1440)
P3 content is 1000px wide; a narrow page is at most 720px
P4 short field "Qty" is 400px wide (max 240; set size="xs|sm")
P5 field "Name" collapsed to 100px
P6 sticky bar .sticky-action-bar has a transparent background
P6 sticky bar .sticky-action-bar (100-900) does not line up with the page content (452-1228)
P7 current rail item contrast 3.2:1 (< 4.5)
P8 dialog 800px wide at x=10
P9 the page container says data-page-width="wide", the route table says "narrow"
P10 Button "Save" contrast 2.1:1 (< 4.5)
P10 Button "Cancel" contrast 3.3:1 (dark scheme)
P11 p.a: clipped
P11 p.b: mid-word
P12 button.last is under the bottom bar by 12 px at the end of the scroll; add clearance (--nav-clearance)
P13 span.name spills 9 px past its tile; give its track min-inline-size: 0 or let it wrap or scroll
P14 .chip "Dairy" is cut by its ellipsis with 40 px spare on its line; let the chips take their natural width (flex 0 1 auto, min-inline-size 0) and no percentage cap
P16 .chip "Beef" is crushed to 8 px: its label is cut by its ellipsis; give the chip its natural width (flex 0 1 auto, min-inline-size) and let the line take fewer chips or a "+N"
P17 .filter-chips "Fish" is cut by its ellipsis (20 px of its label) after the first chip; a chip that does not fit goes into "+N", it is never shown cut or past the line
P17 .filter-chips "Curry" runs 30 px past the end of its line; a chip that does not fit goes into "+N", it is never shown cut or past the line
P18 .chip "Tag": its focus ring is cut by a clipping ancestor by 3 px; do not clip the line, or pad it by the ring (5 px) and the hit area (9 px)
P19 the open popover's end edge is 12 px past its trigger's end edge; end-align it with the trigger
P19 the open popover leaves the page content box (x 10 to 2000, content 100 to 1300); keep it inside the page
P20 row 3 sits 2 px below row 2; it must sit one slot gap (8 px) below it
P20 two panel sections are 4 px apart; space them at least 12 px
P21 the page broke (exception): boom; the chip line must settle at every width, not loop (docs/design/recipes-filter.md 14)
P22 .select "Sort" shows 60 px and cuts 20 px of its value; a chip Select shows its value in full or, when it cannot, is icon-only with its value in its name (system.md 6)

P23 .meta "Fri Dinner +2" shows 90 px and cuts 12 px of its hint with an ellipsis; the Shop's hint names the first Meal Slot and counts the rest, and a Restock reason is compact ("400 ml/1 l") below 420 px, so each fits its row: give the row room (--row-value-min) or shorten the hint
P15 .action-group collapsed to 0 px; give the row a real actions track (max-content) and let the group take its own line on a phone
P15 .action-group clips its label by 4 px; give the row a real actions track (max-content) and let the group take its own line on a phone
P15 .action-group runs 6 px under the actions; give the row a real actions track (max-content) and let the group take its own line on a phone
